EBOOK

The Security Service Provider’s Guide to Improving Productivity with PlexTrac

Crushing The Reporting Time Suck

ACCESS THE EBOOK NOW

In order to serve and protect cyberspace, security service providers need to focus on the right security battles — those that can move the needle on security posture and risk management. PlexTrac addresses all the data integration and management, report writing, white labeling, and assessment administration pain points that consultants routinely face. This eBook provides a direct look into how easy the PlexTrac platform makes it for you and your team to streamline workflows.

You’ll learn how to:

Import and manipulate results of network and app scanning tools

Customize a database of reusable writeups

Export to custom templates or share through a client portal

Streamline assessments, evidence collection, and reporting

Thank you for your interest in
The Security Service Provider’s
Guide to Improving Productivity
with PlexTrac
